arxiv-2209-13038.description: Abstract A variety of constitutive models have been developed for soft tissue mechanics. However, there is no established criterion to select a suitable model for a specific application. Although the model that best fits the experimental data can be deemed the most suitable model, this practice often can be insufficient given the inter-sample variability of experimental observations.

arxiv-2308-13715.title: A Computational Evaluation Framework for Singable Lyric Translation
arxiv-2308-13715.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Lyric translation plays a pivotal role in amplifying the global resonance of music, bridging cultural divides, and fostering universal connections. Translating lyrics, unlike conventional translation tasks, requires a delicate balance between singability and semantics. In this paper, we present a computational framework for the quantitative evaluation of singable lyric translation, which seamlessly integrates musical, linguistic, and cultural dimensions of lyrics. Our comprehensive framework consists of four metrics that measure syllable count distance, phoneme repetition similarity, musical structure distance, and semantic similarity.

arxiv-2407-11098.description: Abstract Controlled fusion energy is deemed pivotal for the advancement of human civilization. arxiv-2510-16946.title: Host-Side Telemetry for Performance Diagnosis in Cloud and HPC GPU Infrastructure
arxiv-2510-16946.creator: Erfan Darzi, Aldo Pareja, Shreeanant Bharadwaj
arxiv-2510-16946.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Erfan Darzi, Aldo Pareja, Shreeanant Bharadwaj. Diagnosing GPU tail latency spikes in cloud and HPC infrastructure is critical for maintaining performance predictability and resource utilization, yet existing monitoring tools lack the granularity for root cause analysis in shared computing environments. We introduce an eBPF-based telemetry system that provides unified host-side monitoring of GPU workloads, correlating eBPF-derived host metrics with GPU-internal events for holistic system observability.

arxiv-2511-09190.title: Iterated Population Based Training with Task-Agnostic Restarts
arxiv-2511-09190.creator: Alexander Chebykin, Tanja Alderliesten, Peter A. N. Bosman
arxiv-2511-09190.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Chebykin, Tanja Alderliesten, Peter A. N. Bosman. Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) can lift the burden of tuning hyperparameters (HPs) of neural networks. HPO algorithms from the Population Based Training (PBT) family are efficient thanks to dynamically adjusting HPs every few steps of the weight optimization. Recent results indicate that the number of steps between HP updates is an important meta-HP of all PBT variants that can substantially affect their performance. Yet, no method or intuition is available for efficiently setting its value.

pmc-11632343.creator: Kelly Higa, Matthew Wingo, Y. Joseph Woo
pmc-11632343.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ng ring to aortic homograft. Central Message

We present a true re-do Commando for mitral valve dehiscence using mitral bioprosthesis and aortic homograft with excess anterior mitral leaflet tissue for aortomitral curtain reconstruction. The Commando procedure, aortic and mitral valve replacement with aortomitral junction reconstruction, first described by Tirone David in 1997, is indicated in infective endocarditis with abscess, severe mitral annular calcification, lack of annular tissue to sew to in the setting of reoperation, and to prevent patient-prosthesis mismatch.
